;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[June 2019 Gulf of Oman incident]], [[Iran–United States relations]], [[Iran–Saudi Arabia relations]]
**Two [[oil tanker]]s, one Norwegian and one Japanese, are damaged and abandoned after being attacked in the [[Gulf of Oman]], with all crew members aboard both ships safely rescued. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-48619771 (BBC News)]
**The [[United States Secretary of State]] [[Mike Pompeo]] and [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Saudi Arabia)|Saudi Arabia Foreign Minister]] [[Adel al-Jubeir]] directly blame [[Iran]] for being behind the attacks on both ships. Iranian officials deny the U.S. claims. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-48630374 (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-tankers-saudi/saudi-arabia-agrees-iran-was-behind-tanker-attacks-saudi-minister-idUSKCN1TE36X (Reuters)]
**The [[United States Central Command]] (CENTCOM) releases a video showing what CENTCOM spokesperson says, is an [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps|Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps']] patrol boat approaching the Kokuka Courageous "and was observed and recorded removing an unexploded [[limpet mine]] from the M/T Kokuka Courageous." [[Iran]] denies involvement. [https://www.apnews.com/6a48842e263541a5b3451f0d41dee01a (Associated Press)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-tanker/u-s-blames-iran-for-tanker-attacks-in-gulf-of-oman-iran-rejects-assertion-idUSKCN1TE0OI (Reuters)]
*A [[Suicide attack|suicide bomber]] kills eleven and injures thirteen in an attack in [[Jalalabad]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://reut.rs/2MMsrTF (Reuters)] [https://www.news18.com/news/world/11-killed-13-injured-in-suicide-bombing-in-afghanistan-isis-afghan-arm-claims-responsibility-2186029.html (News18)]

;Disasters and accidents
*One of the towers of the centuries-old [[Citadel of Ghazni]], [[Afghanistan]], collapses amid heavy rainfall. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-48629680 (BBC News)]

;Law and crime
*[[Flint water crisis]]
**[[Michigan Attorney General]] [[Dana Nessel]] announces that charges will be dropped against eight people in the [[Flint, Michigan|Flint]] water crisis and investigations will be restarted in the scandal, which has plagued the city since 2014. [https://www.wsj.com/articles/michigan-drops-charges-in-flint-water-case-as-it-restarts-investigation-11560452731 (''Wall Street Journal'')] [https://thehill.com/policy/healthcare/state-issues/448419-prosecutors-drop-flint-water-charges-restart-investigation (''The Hill'')]

;Politics and elections
*The [[U.S. Office of Special Counsel]] (OSC) recommends that the [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] remove [[Kellyanne Conway]] from her office as senior aide to President Trump because of her repeated violations of the [[Hatch Act of 1939]]. The Trump administration rejects the OSC's recommendations, saying they "are deeply flawed and violate [Conway's] constitutional rights to free speech and due process." [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2019/06/13/watchdog-kellyanne-conway-should-removed-political-statements/1444402001/ (''USA Today'')]
*[[List of Trump administration dismissals and resignations]]
**[[White House Press Secretary]] [[Sarah Huckabee Sanders]] announces she will resign at the end of June. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/sarah-sanders-leaving-white-house-1.5174520 (CBC)]

;Science and technology
*[[Twitter suspensions]]
**[[Twitter]] says it has removed thousands of accounts that were being run by the [[Iran]]ian government, to spread propaganda and [[fake news]] on the [[social media]] platform. It has also removed over a hundred accounts linked to the [[Catalan independence movement]], and dozens of accounts related to [[Venezuela]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-twitter-iran/twitter-deletes-thousands-of-accounts-tied-to-iran-seeks-to-end-false-info-campaigns-idUSKCN1TE2I9 (Reuters)]

;Sports
*[[2019 NBA Finals]]
**In [[National Basketball Association|basketball]], the [[Toronto Raptors]] defeat the [[Golden State Warriors]] four games to two to win their first [[NBA Finals|NBA championship]]. The Toronto Raptors are also the first NBA team outside of the [[United States]] and the first from [[Canada]] to win the NBA Finals. [https://www.latimes.com/sports/nba/la-sp-raptors-warriors-game-6-20190613-story.html (''Los Angeles Times'')] [https://www.businessinsider.com/raptors-win-nba-championship-over-warriors-2019-6 (''Business Insider'')]
